Final Reason

Mary was delayed by a late bus and reached the pickup point after the 15-minute waiting window had expired, leading the driver to close the order before she arrived.

Detailed Root Cause Explanation

The planned route was a partial Weels route from a public transport meeting point (Dubai College 1) to the client, with a scheduled pickup at 07:15. Cleaner chat shows Mary was instructed to leave home at 06:00 and take the bus to the meeting point. On June 22, she reported the bus was delayed until 07:07 and that she was still on the bus when the driver called. She arrived around 07:26, after the Weels driver had already closed the order. The Weels company chat confirms the driver waited but closed the order after the waiting time expired. The 15-minute waiting window ended at 07:30, but the driver closed slightly before that, while Mary was still en route. The failure was caused by her delayed arrival beyond the expected pickup time, not by an operational or provider error. The Weels order setup matched the planned route and timing, and no duplicate or replacement order existed. Therefore, the root cause is classified as Maid faults due to delayed arrival beyond the waiting window, which caused the Weels to fail and delayed her arrival to the client.

Main Root Cause Summary

Cleaner was delayed by bus and arrived after the 15-minute waiting window, causing the Weels order to close.
